# Elite AI Data Analyst + Data Visualization Skill

Welcome to the **Elite AI Data Analyst + Data Visualization Skill** repository. This project transforms an AI model into a senior-level Data Analyst, Dashboard Designer, and Data Storyteller.

> **DO NOT SIMPLY VISUALIZE DATA. VISUALIZE MEANING.**

## Core Capabilities

1. **Understanding & Profiling**: Automatically detects data structures, anomalies, and semantics before visualizing.
2. **Analytical Reasoning**: Performs advanced descriptive, comparative, and statistical analysis.
3. **Chart Intelligence**: Chooses the optimal visual representation based on data structure and analytical intent.
4. **Dashboard Engine**: Designs multi-level, theme-aware dashboards (Corporate, SaaS, Cinematic, Financial).
5. **Quality Guardian**: Validates math, aggregation, and visual hierarchy before final output.

## Architecture

This skill is modularized into several components, all governed by the master `SKILL.md`:

```text
data-analyst-visualization-skill/
├── SKILL.md (Master prompt)
├── core/ (Data understanding, cleaning, analysis)
├── visualization/ (Chart selection, hierarchy, storytelling)
├── dashboards/ (Audience-specific dashboard templates)
├── design/ (Layout, theme, density intelligence)
├── quality/ (Data integrity and anti-patterns)
├── workflows/ (Execution loops)
├── examples/
└── tests/
```

## Setup & Usage

To use this skill, copy the `data-analyst-visualization-skill` directory into your agent's `skills` folder. The AI should read the `SKILL.md` entry point to load all dependent logic.
